holders.finding: The GFA statutes authorise acquisition in Les Criots without a number or area. Private Belland/Guerrand shareholdings and a general duty to lease do not identify a producer company. No AE97 schedule or current farming is verified.

Registry and 2023 statutes identify Domaine Hubert Lamy (419971130). Older Criots entries concern wine stocks; Puligny AP91 is not Chassagne AE91. No exact AE91 schedule or current farming is verified.

Maison des Grands Crus (395115447), identified by the Prosper Maufoux legal notice, is a partner of holder 778249052 in the 2026 decision. This supports a partner-company link to Maison Prosper Maufoux. No AE90 schedule or current farming is verified.

Three reused d’Auvenay company filings give no individual AE92/AE93 schedule supporting U21930118. Winehog’s 0.0637 ha is a combined holding. No company-record identity crosswalk, producer link or current farming is accepted.

accessGaps: Cadastral named areas are reviewed and the complete INAO outline retained. No producer holding is inferred.
Source boundaries, failed notice downloads and unsearched intervals are reported in the history coverage; none means no historical record.
Current farming remains unconfirmed for every parcel.

Eighteen new distinct company PDFs / 564 pages were screened completely at 150 dpi using RapidOCR/DirectML. Three existing d’Auvenay files / 113 pages were reacquired with unchanged hashes and rechecked, not counted as new PDFs. All 33 pages of an inverted Saint-Aubin filing were also OCR-screened at 180 degrees.

No exact full-reference, individual-area and recorded-holder company filing is accepted. GFA Saint-Joseph’s Les Criots purchase authority has no number or area. Lamy’s older Criots entries are wine stocks; Puligny AP91 is a different section and commune from Chassagne AE91.

GFA Saint-Joseph remains without a producer-company link; private partners and general lease provisions are insufficient. Its two April 2026 copies have different partner lists, preserved as deposited. U21930118 remains without a company-record identity crosswalk despite the separate established 778252445 company.

Maison Prosper Maufoux is a partner-company relationship through 395115447, distinct from holder 778249052. The 2021 approved merger and later company decisions are not evidence of current parcel cultivation.

Both requested Criots Winehog archives were supplied and hashed; all nine referenced images were embedded and reviewed where relevant. Neither article supplies individual number-and-area matches. The d’Auvenay two-parcel 0.0637 ha total remains unallocated.

Three Winehog/trade/critic figures are named-area census only. The Lamy official site gives 18.5 ha for the whole estate, while Prosper Maufoux product text gives 1.57 ha for the whole appellation; neither is imported as a Criots estate holding. The public Hachette text was read through the web tool, but local acquisition failed with a TLS error.

INPI/Pappers returned HTTP 403 on the recorded first batch attempts. Free filing indexes are a bounded corpus, not complete corporate history. Newer unacquired listings, executed leases, subsequent amendments and current performance remain gaps; verified farming stays zero.
